add_book: Add a book. Body: title, author, copies (whole number of copies the library owns). Returns the book including its id and available (copies on the shelf, equal to copies for a new book).
list_books: List all books, each with id, title, author, copies and available.
get_book: Get one book by its id, including available (copies still on the shelf). Path params: id.
borrow_book: A student borrows one copy of a book. Path params: id (the book). Body: student (the student's name). Refused when no copies are on the shelf.
return_book: A student returns a copy of a book. Path params: id (the book). Body: student (the student's name). Refused when that student has no borrowed copy of this book.
